name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.server.QChatRoleSettingActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user edits a server role. It lets the user rename the role, change its permissions, and open its member list.
disableEffect: Users cannot edit a QChat server role's name or permissions through the built-in screen.
